content: {"episode_id":"ep-05010","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, acknowledging that the required prior authorization was missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome and unspecified atrial fibrillation. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and guide further management. We request reconsideration based on this documented clinical indication."}
